FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-001.says: Turbulence, brush 8, pressure 50, jitter 70, stroked across the middle: the stripes there scrambled smoothly.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-003.says: Reflection, brush 8, pressure 100, stroked from the top left to the bottom right: below the line, the stripes above it mirrored.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-004.says: A Warp across the middle first, then Clone, brush 6, pressure 100, one dab near the top with Clone Offset 3 pixels down: the push copied up there.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-005.says: A Warp across the middle first, then Reconstruction (Revert), brush 6, pressure 70, one dab in the middle: the push mostly undone there.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-006.says: A Twirl in the middle and a Shift Pixels down it first, then Reconstruction (Displace) brushed from above the middle to the right: the displacement where it starts carried along.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-007.says: FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-006 with Amplitwist: the turn and swell there carried along too.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-008.says: FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-006 with Affine: the whole local distortion, slant and all.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-009.says: Freeze Area, brush 6, pressure 100, one dab in the middle, then FX-LIQUIFY-002's Warp: the push held back in the middle.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-010.says: FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-009 with a Thaw Area at pressure 50 over the freeze before the Warp: held back half as much.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-011.says: FX-LIQUIFY-002's Warp with Freeze Area Mask 1, a box from (4, 2) to (12, 8): the drawing well inside it does not move.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-012.says: FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-011 with the layer moved three pixels right: the mask is the layer's, so all of it moves with it.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-013.says: Two strokes: a Warp across the middle, then Pucker, brush 10, pressure 100, one dab in the middle: both drawn.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-014.says: FX-LIQUIFY-002's Warp as an earlier stroke and no stroke after it: FX-LIQUIFY-002's frame.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-015.says: Turbulence with the jitter keyed from 10 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: scrambled more as it goes.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-016.says: FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-004 with the Clone Offset keyed from 3 pixels down at frame 0 to 3 pixels up at frame 4: frame 0 FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-004's, then copied from above instead.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-017.says: Freeze Area Mask 2, of one. Nothing to freeze by: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-LIQUIFY-BRUSHES-018.says: Tool "smudge", not one of the twelve. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
